//: Production configuration TEMPLATE for the OpsTrax telematics device edge.
install.sh copies this file to /opt/opstrax/gateway/appsettings.Production.json and then
substitutes GatewayId, BaseUrl and ListenPort from its command-line arguments.
SECRETS ARE NEVER STORED HERE. Gateway:Edge:Forward:Secret and
Gateway:StoreForwardEncryptionKey are supplied through the systemd EnvironmentFile at
Gateway__StoreForwardEncryptionKey. This file is world-readable inside the app directory and
is a deployment artifact; a secret written here would be committed, backed up and shipped.
The gateway refuses to boot in Production without both environment values.

Gateway.//ListenAddress: 0.0.0.0 makes this box a reachable device edge. The IMEI allowlist and the per-gateway HMAC are what keep an open port from being an open relay.

Edge.//Egress: Https keeps this box out of the database entirely: it decodes, gates the IMEI, suppresses replays and forwards over HTTPS. OpsTrax stays the only authority on which tenant owns which device, so a compromised edge cannot reach tenant data.

Allowlist.//Path: Never seeded from the example file. Install it explicitly with install.sh --allowlist <path>; it reloads without a restart.

Outbox.//Path: Encrypted at rest under Gateway__StoreForwardEncryptionKey. Owner-only (0700); the gateway re-asserts the mode at boot.
